title: Path connectedness of multistationarity in a two-layer phosphorylation cascade with a shared phosphatase
shortTitle: One connected region for biochemical multistationarity
oneLine: An exact overlapping fibre joins two auxiliary regions in the full space of reaction rates and conserved totals.
abstract: This unrefereed candidate gives a written proof that the full positive sixteen-dimensional multistationarity region of a two-layer phosphorylation cascade with a shared phosphatase is path connected. Two negative-critical auxiliary components have overlapping physical images, certified by exact rational equilibria. A zero-to-negative coordinate ray includes degenerate multistationary parameters. The claim contradicts Conjecture 4.3 of Kaihnsa and Wang, version 1, and does not concern equilibrium stability or fixed-rate slices.

narration: Imagine two biochemical switches arranged in a cascade, sharing the same enzyme that removes phosphate groups. Some choices of reaction rates and total chemical amounts allow more than one positive equilibrium. Do all those choices belong to one connected region, or are there two separate regions? This candidate gives a written mathematical proof that there is one path-connected region when both rates and totals may vary. The earlier analysis found two separate pieces in auxiliary coordinates. The key is that their images in physical parameters can overlap. Two exact rational equilibrium states, with the same reaction rates and conserved totals, demonstrate that overlap. A further argument joins multistationary parameters with a zero determinant to the negative-determinant region, covering degenerate cases as well. The result addresses a specific conjecture about a two-layer phosphorylation cascade with a shared phosphatase. It does not show that all fixed-rate slices are connected. Nor does having several equilibria establish that several are stable. The certificate uses mathematical parameter values; physiological realism has not been assessed. The release includes the complete paper, rational data, source code and reproducible exact checks. Those checks support the algebraic inputs; the global conclusion rests on the written proof and an established degree theorem. This is an unrefereed Evidence Press candidate dated September twentieth, twenty twenty-six. The full paper and evidence are linked on the release page. This is an AI-generated voice summary, not additional mathematical evidence.
